title: Something I remembered recently…
content: One of my first mallworld dreams that I can remember, I had in 6th grade. (late 20s now) Most of the dream was very typical and I honestly don’t remember much of it other than it being a mallworld dream, but at the beginning, like…My body was turned into water and I had to pass through a grate to get the mall world. It was so uncomfortable to do this. Maybe not painful per se, but really terrible and I was scared I would drown. I remember talking either to my dream self or talking to someone afterwards about how it was really uncomfortable and it sucked that I had to do it to get into this place. Anyone have anything similar? It’s been crazy to me finding this sub and the bathroom maze one. Some of y’all’s dreams and mine are way too similar!!
